reasons.persona_fit: Directly addresses a small-business owner in Bareni's calm, practical voice, focusing on workflow scoping and human controls without hype or unauthorized CTAs.
reasons.clarity: Logical structure, clear contrast between vague goals and bounded workflows, and unambiguous framing that is easy to follow on a first read.
reasons.actionability: Provides a crisp diagnostic rule (in/decision/out/out-of-scope) and an immediate, feasible next step tailored to an owner-operator.
reasons.factual_grounding: Adheres strictly to approved evidence, making no ungrounded customer, result, or capability claims.
